LXPB Hand-Labeling Report

Each row is a completed LXPB retest. Phase 0 = formation bar (level created), Phase 1 = breakout bar, Phase 2 = retest bar -- marked with dots/arrows on the expandable H1 chart, which spans 8 bars before Phase 0 through 8 bars after Phase 2. Gold line = this row's own level; blue/red dashed lines = other same-type LXPB levels within 20 ticks (5.00 pts) broken out by the retest time, for judging confluence clusters. Each feature checkbox (and the overall "Valid" verdict) is pre-checked from a computed default -- the small grey hint text explains why -- but the reviewer's tick is final and can flip any of them. Labels persist in this browser's localStorage and can be exported/imported as CSV (top-right buttons).
